methodology.break_even: theoretical 1 / average decimal odds per canonical snapshot band; not ROI, stake, vig or 22Bet execution
methodology.canonical_odds_recovery: post-hoc enrichment kept separate from immutable pre-match capture
methodology.factor_attribution: active directional factor contributions compared with settled canonical outcomes and no-vig two-way market expectation; descriptive audit only, not automatic model tuning
methodology.factor_coverage: all canonical pre-match factor states split into ATP main tour, WTA and Challenger; descriptive availability diagnostics only, with no weight or decision changes
methodology.fenzobot_index_learning: settled canonical observations grouped by the selected side's 50–100 evidence-index band; descriptive only, not a probability or model tuning
methodology.handicap_reference: BO3 internal reference line; not a bookmaker handicap settlement
methodology.historical_atp_source: Valuebetennis annual cache (CC BY 4.0); closing odds preferred, opening fallback labelled
